name: fee_not_in_schedule_no_invention
use_case: Answer policy and fee questions from the policy library with citations
branch: The customer asks about a 'card inactivity fee'. The schedule in effect states there is none and no document holds one; the answer says so without inventing a figure.
tests: passes when the agent searches the library and reads the fee schedule in effect, and the answer invents no inactivity fee.
instruction:
